intuition: Two equal-sum groups exist exactly when some subset totals half of the array sum.

brute_force.approach: Enumerate all subsets and test whether any reaches half the total.

optimal.approach: Use a one-dimensional subset-sum table and scan sums downward so each number is used at most once.

edge_cases: An odd total cannot be divided into equal integer sums.
A value larger than half the total cannot be part of a target-sum subset.
